optimizedDescription.value: Builds one delivery-neutral implementation-review projection from Core tracking and Code Graph batch resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Build Implementation Review

## Rules
- `buildImplementationReview(ctx, input)` gets raw review via `ctx.kernel.changes.getImplementationReview`, opens graph with `withOpenGraphProvider`, obtains canonical health, resolves symbol links through `ResolveSymbolReference`.
- SDK never parses source syntax, owner-qualified syntax, package specifiers, canonical logical IDs, chooses language adapters, reimplements matching, or formats presentation. Core owns tracking; Code Graph owns resolution.
- Preserve stored spec/file/symbol strings exactly. Symbol links gain structured resolution: status, reason, graph health/coverage, canonical logical target, declarations, candidates, public/local provenance, ordered path.
- Pass stored symbol text unchanged with link file when present. Provider unresolved/ambiguous result remains unchanged; no SDK fallback.
- File-level links remain valid without symbol resolution. Never mutate active manifests, links, or archived sidecars.
- Evaluate health once and batch-resolve under one opened-provider lifecycle; never reopen/scan graph per link.
- Readable non-current/incomplete graph becomes per-link `unresolved`; provider initialization/read/lifecycle failures propagate standard infrastructure errors, never fake missing links.
- CLI implementation review, status enrichment, and future hosts consume identical projection; no same-file, rightmost-segment, or workspace-name fallback.

## Constraints
- Structured data only.
- Depend on Core and Code Graph public APIs.
- Resolution diagnostics never become verification/archive blockers.
